mistakes.text: He checked six sources tonight, and the pile is still growing.
mistakes.normalized: he checked six sources tonight and the pile is still growing
mistakes.feedback_sk: Obdobie „tonight“ ešte neskončilo, preto je lepší Present Perfect: „has checked“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Období „tonight“ ještě neskončilo, proto je lepší Present Perfect: „has checked“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “tonight” is not over yet, so Present Perfect is better: “has checked”.

mistakes.text: He has been checking six sources tonight, and the pile is still growing.
mistakes.normalized: he has been checking six sources tonight and the pile is still growing
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri počte hotových dejov („six sources“) patrí Present Perfect Simple: „has checked“, nie „has been checking“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U počtu hotových dějů („six sources“) patří Present Perfect Simple: „has checked“, ne „has been checking“.
mistakes.feedback_en: When you count finished actions (“six sources”), use Present Perfect Simple: “has checked”, not “has been checking”.
